item.title: Drive Radio — August 6, 2026
item.description: - Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs: A major leadership shakeup at Google's AI crown jewel just as the Gemini vs ChatGPT race heats up. (https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/next-chapter-ai-momentum/) - Nashville uses eminent domain to block data center near zoo: A city just seized land to stop an AI data center — a sign of the growing local backlash to Big Tech's infrastructure land grab. (https://www.costar.com/article/970809918/nashville-council-approves-eminent-domain-action-to-halt-data-center-project) - Virginia Orders Data Centers to Pay for Dedicated New Electric Infrastructure: The state hosting most of the world's internet traffic just forced data centers to foot their own power bill. (https://www.realtor.com/news/real-estate-news/virginia-data-center-electric-infrastructure-spanberger/) - Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work: Cloudflare wants to be the operating system for the AI agent era, not just the plumbing underneath it. (https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-os/) - I'm switching my phone from Android to Linux: One developer's quiet rebellion against Google's grip on Android, even if it means losing half his apps. (https://runarcn.no/android-to-linux/) - Prime Agent: A self-improving RLM agent: An AI agent that debugs and improves its own reasoning loop without retraining — a possible glimpse at AI's next big leap. (https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/prime-agent)

item.title: Drive Radio — August 6, 2026
item.description: - Changes at Google DeepMind: Hassabis to Chair, Jeff Dean departs: A surprising leadership shakeup at the peak of Google's AI momentum raises questions about what's really happening behind the scenes. (https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/next-chapter-ai-momentum/) - DeepSeek planning to significantly raise prices: The AI disruptor famous for dirt-cheap models is about to prove that cheap AI was never actually free. (https://platform.deepseek.com/usage) - Humans missed 1 in 3 threats approving AI agent commands across 40k game runs: A wild new stat shows human oversight of AI agents might be more theater than safety net. (https://scalex.dev/blog/ai-agent-permissions-stats/) - Discovery Loop: The addictive new curiosity rabbit-hole site that ate Hacker News' entire day. (https://www.discoveryloop.com/) - Crime Pays but Botany Doesn't: A botanist's reading list on why plant science gets no love became an unlikely hit — and a metaphor for underfunded, unglamorous work everywhere. (https://www.crimepaysbutbotanydoesnt.com/reading-list)
